name: sk-doc
description: Documentation & OpenCode-component authoring parent hub. One advisor identity that routes through mode-registry.json + hub-router.json to fifteen workflow modes across fourteen nested workflow packets: sk-create-skill (+ sk-create-skill-parent), sk-create-readme, sk-create-agent, sk-create-command, sk-create-feature-catalog, sk-create-manual-testing-playbook, sk-create-benchmark, sk-create-changelog, sk-create-diff (local before/after document reviews), sk-create-repo-rule, sk-create-frontmatter (the YAML frontmatter contract: per-class field rules, the description budget, and the 4-part version derivation), sk-create-goal (authors packet goal.md files: the durable directive, three to seven self-contained completion criteria, and the phase-parent binding table), sk-create-with-human-voice (apply or score prose against the Human Voice Rules, with a scope gate, a scanner that parses the standard at run time, and a re-scan after the rewrite), and sk-create-quality-control (validate/score/optimize an existing doc). The universal sk-create-quality-control pipeline — validators, global standards, frontmatter/llms/template assets — lives once in shared/ and is consumed by every packet. Workflow-only hub: no surface axis, zero named extensions.
